### Getting a fresh cookie (or token)

Sessions expire, and a real cookie should never be saved in a report, so the commands above use a placeholder. To fill it in:

1. In your browser, open the site (and sign in if it needs an account).
2. Open dev tools (F12) and go to the **Network** tab.
3. Repeat the action from the step-by-step section so the request appears in the list.
4. Click that request, open **Headers**, and find **Request Headers -> Cookie** (or **Authorization**).
5. Copy the value and paste it over the placeholder. Treat it like a password: don't commit it or send it around.

## 5. Why this matters

> *Generic text - the script cannot know the real business impact of this field. Tailor it before sharing.*

A value the site **sends** is a value the caller controls: the server should validate it (type, range, ownership) instead of trusting the page that produced it. A value the server **sends back** can reveal data or internal state, so it is worth checking that it only contains what the caller is meant to see. Calling the API directly (section 4) is the quickest way to test both, because it skips any checks the web page does in the browser.
